svg.title: Annual Parenting Overnights Comparison (Uniform Domestic Relations Act § 402)
svg.desc: Comparison of Respondent's Proposed Equal 50/50 Plan for the Three Minor Children (182.5 overnights each) versus Petitioner's Proposed 90-Overnight Restriction (24.7% Respondent, 75.3% Petitioner).
svg.text: Statutory Best-Interests Parenting Time (Ages 15, 11 & 6) — Annual Overnights (365 Days)
Respondent's Proposal (Ex. L): Equal 2-2-5-5 Rotation with Seamless Monday/Wednesday School Exchanges
Petitioner's Proposal: Restricts Respondent to 90 Overnights/Year + Replaces Available Parent with $2,400/mo After-School Agency (OP Ex. 4)
✓ Temporary Orders (Ex. N ¶ 8): Court found NO basis to restrict Respondent's parenting time; parties practiced 50/50 from March 1 to May 1, 2030.
